notes: No seed website in the SOS list; one web search found www.comanchecountytx.gov (CivicPlus) and the older newtools.cira.state.tx.us pages. No Clarity or vendor site found. Reports are Hart PDFs (Cumulative and Precinct Results). The DocumentCenter server sets Last-Modified to the request time (Fri, 02 Oct 2026), so it gives no upload evidence; times used are printed run times (PDF CreationDate agrees, e.g. runoff cumulative 2026-05-27 01:42:16 UTC). Pattern also seen in 2024 primary and runoff archive file names (Cumulative Results on election night, Precinct Results days later). 2024 general undetermined (check 3 pending; wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: The 2026 primary and 2026 runoff are both LATER (check 2: county totals on election night, precinct reports printed after), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS. Confidence low because the server gives no upload times.

2024_general.fact: The Archived Elections page lists for 11-5-24 only notices, orders, sample ballots and polling places; no 2024 general results file is posted. Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: 'Unofficial - Results' (View/1420) is a Hart 'Cumulative Results Report Comanche County Unofficial Results 2026 March 3rd Joint Primary Election ... Polling Places Reporting 11 of 12 ... Run Time 9:14 PM Run Date 03/03/2026' (county totals). The 'Precinct by Precinct Report' (View/1446) is a 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results ... Polling Places Reporting 12 of 12 ... Run Time 10:08 AM Run Date 03/12/2026', nine days later. The server returns the request time as Last-Modified, so there is no upload-time evidence.

2026_runoff.fact: 'Unofficial - Results' (View/1642) is a Hart 'Cumulative Results Report ... 2026 May 26th Joint Primary Runoff ... Polling Places Reporting 8 of 9 ... Run Time 8:41 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' (county totals). The 'Precinct by Precinct Report' (View/1653) is a 'Precinct Results Report Unofficial Results ... Run Time 3:15 PM Run Date 05/27/2026', the afternoon after election night. No server upload times available.
